key_issues: aria-label used on a non-semantic <div> without a valid role (.menu-btn) (WCAG 4.1.2).
No clear bypass mechanism/landmarks/heading structure detected (skip link, <main>, <header>, <h1>) (WCAG 2.4.1).
fix_strategy: Convert the menu control from a <div> to a semantic <button> with an accessible name; keep styling and structure intact.
Add a skip link, wrap top area in <header>, add <main id="main"> landmark, and add a visually-hidden <h1> to provide a proper page heading without changing the visual design.

changes.what_changed: Added a descriptive <title>UIST 2026 – Detroit, MI</title> in the document <head>.
Replaced <div class="menu-btn" aria-label="Menu"> with a semantic <button type="button" class="menu-btn" aria-label="Menu"> to avoid prohibited ARIA usage and improve accessibility.
Added a skip link, introduced <header> and <main id="main"> landmarks, and added a visually-hidden <h1> to establish a meaningful heading structure while preserving the existing visual layout.
